# M9: the warnings that types2 and the go command report resolve through the
# same policy as the lints of the compiler. The group severity of logos.toml
# [lints] decides whether suspicious::unapplied_struct_default,
# suspicious::side_effect_before_sort, and portability::alias_extension warn,
# fail the build, or stay silent; //logos:allow(<rule>) silences each of them
# under warn and under deny; forbid cannot be silenced, and the directive on
# a forbid rule is itself an error.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# The checker rules: the group default is warn.
cd suspicious
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sd0$GOEXE ./sd
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:8:8: warning: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\] zero declaration of Cfg with field defaults'
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:9:7: warning: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\] zero declaration of Cfg with field defaults'
exists $WORK/bin/sd0$GOEXE
logos build -o $WORK/bin/se0$GOEXE ./se
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:6:40: warning: \[suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\] chain lambda with a call of unknown purity before sortBy'
exists $WORK/bin/se0$GOEXE

# A directive on the line above the statement silences each rule under warn.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sdok0$GOEXE ./sdok
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/sdok0$GOEXE
logos build -o $WORK/bin/seok0$GOEXE ./seok
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/seok0$GOEXE

# logos lint resolves the same findings under the same policy.
logos lint ./sd ./se ./sdok ./seok
stderr -count=2 'warning: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\]'
stderr -count=1 'warning: \[suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\]'

# suspicious = "deny" makes each finding an error with no warning prefix, and
# no binary is written.
cp logos-deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sd1$GOEXE ./sd
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:8:8: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\] zero declaration of Cfg with field defaults'
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:9:7: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\] zero declaration of Cfg with field defaults'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/sd1$GOEXE
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/se1$GOEXE ./se
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:6:40: \[suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\] chain lambda with a call of unknown purity before sortBy'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/se1$GOEXE

# The directive silences a deny rule.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sdok1$GOEXE ./sdok
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/sdok1$GOEXE
logos build -o $WORK/bin/seok1$GOEXE ./seok
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/seok1$GOEXE

# logos lint fails on the deny findings and reports them together.
! logos lint ./sd ./se ./sdok ./seok
stderr -count=2 'main\.lgo:[89]:[78]: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\]'
stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:6:40: \[suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\]'
! stderr 'warning:'

# suspicious = "allow" is silent.
cp logos-allow.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sd2$GOEXE ./sd
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/sd2$GOEXE
logos build -o $WORK/bin/se2$GOEXE ./se
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/se2$GOEXE

# suspicious = "forbid" ignores the directive, which is an error of its own.
cp logos-forbid.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sd3$GOEXE ./sd
stderr 'main\.lgo:8:8: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\]'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sdok3$GOEXE ./sdok
stderr 'main\.lgo:8:2: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\] //logos:allow\(suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\)'
stderr 'main\.lgo:9:8: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/sdok3$GOEXE
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/seok3$GOEXE ./seok
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\] //logos:allow\(suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\)'
stderr 'main\.lgo:7:\d+: \[suspicious::side_effect_before_sort\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/seok3$GOEXE

# The same policy with an explicit warn prints the warning again.
cp logos-warn.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sd4$GOEXE ./sd
stderr -count=2 'warning: \[suspicious::unapplied_struct_default\]'
cd ..

# The go command rule: the group default is warn.
cd alias
logos build ./plain
stderr -count=1 'go: warning: \[portability::alias_extension\] main\.📜: loGo/s alias extension file'
logos build ./ok
! stderr .
logos build ./detached
stderr -count=1 'go: warning: \[portability::alias_extension\] d\.📜: loGo/s alias extension file'

# portability = "deny" fails the load of the package, and the directive above
# the package clause silences it.
cp logos-deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build ./plain
stderr -count=1 '^\[portability::alias_extension\] main\.📜: loGo/s alias extension file'
! stderr 'warning:'
logos build ./ok
! stderr .
! logos build ./detached
stderr '\[portability::alias_extension\] d\.📜'

# Every alias file of a package is an error, test files included.
! logos build ./pair
stderr -count=1 '\[portability::alias_extension\] a\.📜'
stderr -count=1 '\[portability::alias_extension\] b\.⚡'

# portability = "allow" is silent.
cp logos-allow.toml logos.toml
logos build ./plain
! stderr .
logos build ./detached
! stderr .

# portability = "forbid" ignores the directive, which is an error of its own.
cp logos-forbid.toml logos.toml
! logos build ./plain
stderr '\[portability::alias_extension\] main\.📜'
! logos build ./ok
stderr '\[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\] ok\.📜:1:1: //logos:allow\(portability::alias_extension\)'
stderr '\[portability::alias_extension\] ok\.📜'
cd ..

# A canonical .lgo file stays silent under deny in a dotted module.
cd canonical
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

-- suspicious/go.mod --
module example.com/suspicious

go 1.27

-- suspicious/logos-deny.toml --
[lints]
suspicious = "deny"

-- suspicious/logos-allow.toml --
[lints]
suspicious = "allow"

-- suspicious/logos-forbid.toml --
[lints]
suspicious = "forbid"

-- suspicious/logos-warn.toml --
[lints]
suspicious = "warn"

-- suspicious/sd/main.lgo --
package main

type Cfg struct {
	Port int32 = 8080
}

func main() {
	var c Cfg
	p := new(Cfg)
	println(c.Port, p.Port)
}

-- suspicious/sdok/main.lgo --
package main

type Cfg struct {
	Port int32 = 8080
}

func main() {
	//logos:allow(suspicious::unapplied_struct_default)
	var c Cfg
	println(c.Port)
}

-- suspicious/se/main.lgo --
package main

func bump(x int) int { return 2 * x }

func main() {
	r := []int{3, 1, 2}.map(x => bump(x)).sortBy(x => x)
	println(len(r))
}

-- suspicious/seok/main.lgo --
package main

func bump(x int) int { return 2 * x }

func main() {
	//logos:allow(suspicious::side_effect_before_sort)
	r := []int{3, 1, 2}.map(x => bump(x)).sortBy(x => x)
	println(len(r))
}

-- alias/go.mod --
module example.com/alias

go 1.27

-- alias/logos-deny.toml --
[lints]
portability = "deny"

-- alias/logos-allow.toml --
[lints]
portability = "allow"

-- alias/logos-forbid.toml --
[lints]
portability = "forbid"

-- alias/plain/main.📜 --
package plain

func Name() string { return "plain" }

-- alias/ok/ok.📜 --
//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)
package ok

func Name() string { return "ok" }

-- alias/detached/d.📜 --
//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)

package detached

func Name() string { return "detached" }

-- alias/pair/a.📜 --
package pair

func A() string { return "a" }

-- alias/pair/b.⚡ --
package pair

func B() string { return "b" }

-- canonical/go.mod --
module example.com/canonical

go 1.27

-- canonical/logos.toml --
[lints]
portability = "deny"

-- canonical/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	println("canonical")
}
